message.content:
Based on my search, **Miraculous Ladybug Season 2 Episode 12 already came out years ago**. It was titled **"Gorizilla"** and aired on **March 14, 2018** in Canada on Family Channel. In the U.S., it premiered on **March 30, 2018** on Netflix.

However, there seems to be some confusion in episode numbering. According to the production order, "Gorizilla" is episode 12, but in the French airing order, **"Captain Hardrock"** (which aired April 10, 2018 in Switzerland and March 30, 2018 in the USA on Netflix) was sometimes listed as episode 12 in certain regions.

Season 2 of Miraculous Ladybug originally ran from **October 2017 to November 2018**, so all episodes from that season have been released for several years now. The show is currently much further along, with Season 6 having premiered in January 2025.

If you're looking for new Miraculous Ladybug content in 2026, the spin-off series **Miraculous Chibi Season 2** has episodes scheduled to release throughout 2025-2026, with episodes continuing into May 2026.
